name: animejs
description: Comprehensive skill for Anime.js v4 - a fast and flexible JavaScript animation library. This skill should be used when implementing web animations, creating timelines, working with SVG animations, scroll-based animations, draggable elements, staggered effects, or any JavaScript-based animation on the web. Triggers on: "anime.js", "animejs", "animate elements", "CSS animation with JS", "timeline animation", "stagger animation", "SVG morphing", "motion path", "scroll animation", "draggable", "spring animation", "keyframe animation".
author: bowtiedswan
